# IHRU national rehousing-needs survey, 2018

The IHRU's [Levantamento Nacional das Necessidades de Realojamento
Habitacional](https://www.portaldahabitacao.pt/estudos-e-relat%C3%B3rios),
final report dated **February 2018**, describes precarious housing needs
reported by Portuguese municipalities.

Its published national headline is **25,762 households** in unsatisfactory
housing across **187 municipalities**. The downstream research project has
manually transcribed the report's **308 Annex 4 rows**, while preserving
three missing responses (Estremoz `n/a`; Fronteira and Góis blank). These are
missing observations, not reported zeros.

The originally retrieved official PDF URL stopped working for the downstream
project; its pinned file came from the [Internet Archive's unmodified
14 April 2018 capture](http://web.archive.org/web/20180414024207id_/http://www.portaldahabitacao.pt/opencms/export/sites/portal/pt/portal/habitacao/levantamento_necessidades_habitacionais/Relatorio_Final_Necessidades_Realojamento.pdf).
The [IHRU portal](https://portaldahabitacao.pt/documents/20126/58203/Relatorio_Final_Necessidades_Realojamento.pdf/d67e9ed8-93aa-d65a-eb36-b586389b2295?t=1550355947650)
also exposes an official report link; its byte identity must **not** be
assumed identical to the archived snapshot.

- Archived downstream filename: `ihru_levantamento_2018.pdf`.
- SHA-256 in `data/sources/rent_affordability_sources.json`:
  `0900c0bead32c0f6c0354f5ece773b08e0baa5bc2ad668affec03e06e5e0e863`.
- Recorded size: 3,321,554 bytes; downstream retrieval: 30 October 2026.

This is a **2018 historical needs baseline**, not a 2026 housing waiting
list or present-day forecast. The annex transcription is project-local.
**External metadata only**; reuse terms for centrally mirroring the source
or transcribed annex are unverified.
